Begin the story
The unexpected beginning

To me, it was you.

You came to me when I least expected it.

When I began this journey, I carried a small White Rabbit with me. To anyone else it was simply a stuffed rabbit.

To me, it was you.

The White Rabbit traveled beside me through Scotland, London, Germany, and Austria. Every castle, every mountain, every winding road, every quiet morning. It returned home a little more worn than when it left—and I would not change that. Those marks are not flaws. They are proof that it truly journeyed.

To me, the White Rabbit will always represent you—a quiet companion I carried with me in thought, no matter how far from home I wandered.

I do not know every chapter of your past, but I do know you have had to endure and overcome more than most people ever see. I admire that quiet courage. Like the White Rabbit, your story symbolizes far more than what appears on the surface. The greatest adventures often begin when we choose to follow the unexpected.

Throughout this journey, it became a quiet reminder that some people never truly leave your side, no matter the distance.

Close to my heart—my White Rabbit, carried through every country, every road, and every adventure.
The journey

One flower from every place.

One of the most beautiful places I have ever visited.

At every place I visited, I gathered a flower.

Not because it was rare.

Not because it was perfect.

Because in that place, at that moment, I found myself thinking of you.

Pressed together, they became something greater than flowers. They became a map of the journey—not where my feet wandered, but where my thoughts remained.

The story behind each gift

Chosen with intention.

Every item in this box was chosen with intention. Alone, they are simply gifts. Together, they tell a story.

The Purple Dragon

The Purple Dragon represents Ludwig—a creature of courage, wisdom, and quiet strength. Dragons do not waste their power proving themselves; they guard what matters. It is a reminder that true strength is found not in force, but in character.

The Leather Billfold

The Leather Billfold represents honesty and integrity. Leather becomes stronger with time, carrying the marks of every journey. Like a person’s word, its value is measured not by how new it is, but by how faithfully it endures.

The Pocket Knife from London

The Pocket Knife from London symbolizes dependability. A good knife is not carried for display but because, when the moment comes, it can always be counted on. It reminds me that reliability is one of the rarest and most valuable qualities a person can possess.

The Haller Messer from Germany

The Haller Messer from Germany represents loyalty and honor. Historically, it was the tool and companion of those who worked hard, stood by their convictions, and protected those entrusted to them. Loyalty is not loud—it is proven in consistency, especially when it costs something.

The Medieval Green Tunic

The Medieval Green Tunic reminds us that the greatest warriors were recognized long before they ever wore armor. Their reputation was built on humility, service, and unwavering principles. Green, the color of growth and steadfastness, symbolizes a life rooted deeply enough to weather every season.

What I brought home

More than souvenirs.

Each of these gifts comes from places I have walked and memories I have made.

I wanted to bring back more than souvenirs—I wanted to bring back symbols.

May they remind you that honesty builds trust, loyalty earns respect, dependability creates security, and strength is measured not by power, but by the character that carries it.

Some people collect things.

I chose to collect reminders.

Reminders of the places that changed me.

Reminders of the qualities I admire in you.

And reminders that sometimes the greatest souvenirs are not the things we bring home…

They are the people we carry with us.
I love you.
You were with me every step of the way.
Katie
